description: This file defines a Java Servlet Filter named CacheFilter that is used within the OFBiz framework to control cache behavior and security, specifically to mitigate certain security issues by controlling request processing and headers.

classes.name: CacheFilter
classes.description: A servlet filter class in OFBiz designed to intercept HTTP requests and responses to manage caching and security-related headers, and provide basic filter lifecycle management.

methods.name: doFilter
methods.description: Processes each incoming request to potentially modify cache behavior or security headers, then passes the request along the filter chain.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the filter with its configuration when the web application starts.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the filter is taken out of service.
